face.name: 至尊盗王拉法姆
face.text: 嘲讽 战吼：将你的手牌和牌库里的卡牌替换为传说随从。

face.text: Taunt Battlecry: Replace your hand and deck with Legendary minions.
face.flavorText: Minions must wash hands before being LIQUIDATED AND REPLACED BY SOMEONE BETTER.

face.name: 利亚姆王子
face.text: 战吼：将你牌库中所有法力值消耗为（1）的牌变为传说随从牌。

face.name: Prince Liam
face.text: Battlecry: Transform all 1-Cost cards in your deck into Legendary minions.
face.flavorText: "I have a very particular set of skills. Skills that make me a nightmare for witches like you."

face.name: 莉莉安·沃斯
face.text: 战吼：随机将你手牌中所有的法术牌替换成（你对手职业的）法术牌。

face.name: Lilian Voss
face.text: Battlecry: Replace spells in your hand with random spells (from your opponent's class).
face.flavorText: She doesn't feel pity, or remorse, or fear. And she absolutely will not stop... ever, until all necromancers are dead.

face.name: Lady Prestor
face.text: Battlecry: Transform minions in your deck into random Dragons. (They keep their original stats and Cost.)
face.flavorText: To her credit, the best bodyguard for the king WOULD be a dragon in disguise.

face.name: 天空慈母艾维娜
face.text: 战吼：随机将10张传说随从牌洗入你的牌库，其法力值消耗为（1）点。

face.name: Sky Mother Aviana
face.text: Battlecry: Shuffle 10 random Legendary minions into your deck. They cost (1).
face.flavorText: It's a bird! It's a plane! It's 10 copies of Leeroy Jenkins!

face.name: 皮普希·彩蹄
face.text: 亡语：随机从你的牌库中召唤圣盾，突袭和嘲讽随从各一个。
face.flavorText: “大地母亲指引着我的笔触，赐予我点睛之笔。”

face.name: Pipsi Painthoof
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon a random Divine Shield, Rush, and Taunt minion from your deck.
face.flavorText: "Earthmother guide my paintbrush strokes, especially on the eyes."

face.name: 高阶教徒巴萨莱弗
face.text: 战吼：复活在你的上回合之后死亡的所有友方亡灵。

face.name: High Cultist Basaleph
face.text: Battlecry: Resurrect all friendly Undead that died after your last turn.
face.flavorText: "It's not a cult! It's a collection of like-minded individuals that enjoy undead. And rituals. And doing what I say. "

face.name: Infiltrator Lilian
face.text: Stealth Deathrattle: Summon a 4/2 Forsaken Lilian that attacks a random enemy.
face.flavorText: She'll get to the bottom of this even if it kills her. Twice!

local_policies: Ten original assigned roots and one actual child retain all complete raw records and all24 bilingual first-party observations. Four evidence-only rows are not physical generated candidates. Full original732 past identities and all six original domains remain open; no executable-subset pool, no extra Standard roots.

Rafaam uses captured original remaining hand/deck references and full ordinary current Legendary-minion inventory. Liam captures original local-cost1 deck cards before transformations, not hand cards or a later same-ID reentry. Each transformation uses original shared reset/lifecycle and validates the complete declared candidate pool before RNG.

Voss captures original opponent current playable hero class and all original held spells. Explicit class query includes full current class spell inventory and no neutral/substitute mage or implemented subset. Unknown current class is explicit unsupported and rolls back. Exact unusual multi-class/CN hero boundaries remain uncalibrated.

Polkelt orders original complete physical deck by clamped local_cost into descending tiers. Uniform MT19937 shuffle only within tied tiers, no RNG for untied/empty tiers; old positional information is concealed. Source-bound OrderDeckByCost delegates one ordinary full ReorderZone. It is not a semantic shuffle or a persistent future-draw sorter. Local-vs-intrinsic current Cost and exact tied-card official policy are declared local boundaries.

Prestor captures original own-deck MINION physical references and original current Attack/max Health/local Cost before any transform. Existing TransformStoredFromPool only extends its complete retained-stat hand form to the exact full collectible Dragon MINION query in DECK. No new stat executor, retained field or later requery. Source-bound same actual physical cards reset printed abilities normally; copied numbers remain ordinary removable stat/cost attachments. Printed-versus-pretransform bonuses and exact CN windows remain local policies.

Aviana freezes ten full ordinary current Legendary-minion draws with replacement, original one-cost creation grants and one original semantic generated shuffle group. It then uses original ShuffleDeck to randomise the entire current physical deck, including previously ordered cards; no ten fabricated numeric grants or alternate shuffle scheduler. Existing random-insertion shuffle-group notification timing is preserved before that final physical shuffle and is an explicitly recorded local edge. Failed insertion/capacity follows original creator; no executable subset or replacement fallback.

Pipsi has exactly three independent ordered original own-deck recruit requests: printed Divine Shield, Rush, Taunt. Each re-queries remaining physical candidates, removes selected original card, keeps current material and no Battlecry, shared quantity/full-board policies. One multi-keyword physical card cannot fill multiple slots once removed. Existing printed keyword-query policy is explicit; granted/removed stored keywords and precise official ordering remain uncalibrated, not claimed current-keyword support.

Basaleph captures actual friendly BOARD minion deaths strictly after the last genuinely closed own OwnerTurnRecord.turn, or from turn1 if no previous interval, then tests original frozen current Undead tribe and passes exact original death_ids to ordinary attributed Resurrect. No parity, new death counter, repeated pool consumption or history rewrite. Previous-own-end reaction/window attribution remains local pending CN validation.

Alura uses original Spellburst once and original CastRandomDeckSpell, admitting max_cost=None only for the source-bound PreferredMinionTarget form. It does not crop original spells to an invented max mana; existing handler selects actual physical deck spell, casts without normal payment, consumes original card, prefers original uninterrupted source residence when legal, otherwise original random targeting. Empty deck, cast failures, waiting, repeat and source lifecycle stay shared.

Lilian real natural/early Deathrattle uses exact SCH_426t4/2 physical face, original SummonByCard material and original_named_reference then shared AttackRandomEnemyCharacter. Every delivered quantity body owns its original followup; full board or departed/reentered original beneficiary does not attack a substitute. No token Battlecry, second combat executor or guessed child aliases.

Uncertain rules/notification timing and source versions stay explicit local differences; no version/hotfix/CN calibration claim, no wait for user experiments. Unknown eligible content remains an explicit error rather than whiteboard or candidate deletion. This does not bind complete past source or finish the broader dedicated-pool goal.
